title: feat(app-shell): source-page editor in inspector Source tab + deep-linked menu selection
body:
## Summary

Fixes two issues on the Studio **Interfaces** pillar for `kind:'html'` / `kind:'react'` source pages (the pages that are a `source` string, not a block tree — ADR-0080/0081):

1. **Code editor relocated to a "Source" tab in the right inspector.** Previously the code editor occupied the canvas (code-left / preview-right split) while the inspector showed a dead "edit it on the left" message. Now the canvas shows only the **live preview** (full width) and the code editor lives in a dedicated **Source** tab in the properties panel. Edits flow through the shared draft, so the preview updates live.

2. **No more spurious syntax errors.** The Monaco editor was configured with `language="typescript"` + a `.tsx` path, so its TypeScript worker ran full semantic/syntax validation over JSX-flavoured HTML (intrinsic tags like `<flex>`, no `import React`, `style={{…}}` object literals) — flooding the gutter with red squiggles that mean nothing here. A `beforeMount` hook now disables semantic/syntax diagnostics and configures JSX on the TS worker. The live preview + server-side validation remain the real source of truth.

Plus the requested navigation behaviour:

3. **Menu selection is now deep-linked.** Selecting a menu writes `?surface=<type>:<name>` to the URL, so the open design surface is shareable and survives a reload instead of snapping back to the first nav leaf.

## Changes

- `previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx` — new `mode` prop (`split` | `editor` | `preview`) to split the editor and preview halves apart; `configureMonacoForSource` (`beforeMount`) to silence bogus TS diagnostics and set JSX compiler options.
- `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — source pages render preview-only in the canvas and a tabbed inspector (`Source` / `Properties`) hosting the editor; the inspector widens to fit code; `?surface=` deep-link capture (on mount), restore (app-load), and mirror (on selection change); `findSurfaceInTree` helper.
- `metadata-admin/nav-selection.ts` — `DESIGNER_SURFACE_PARAM`, `formatSurfaceParam`, `parseSurfaceParam`.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — `tabSource` / `tabProps` labels (EN + zh-CN) and updated source-page hint.

## Testing

- `nav-selection.surface.test.ts` (new) — round-trip / edge cases for the surface param helpers.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` — clean.
- `eslint` on changed files — no new errors.
- Existing studio-design + preview + studio-locale suites — 40 passed.
